content.text: {"findings":[{"field":"Production context","problem":"The hint contains the answer word כלב itself, giving it away.","rewrite":"the animal that barks"},{"field":"Examples","problem":"The adjectives are feminine (גדולה ונחמדה) but כלב is masculine, so they must agree as masculine.","rewrite":"הכלב שלי גדול ונחמד. — My dog is big and nice."},{"field":"Notes","problem":"The note is wrong: כלב is masculine, and the female dog is כלבה.","rewrite":"כלב is masculine; a female dog is כלבה."}]}
